lead_headline: Mendocino Farms opens third Denver location at Union Station today while Reunion Bread's James Beard-nominated bakery lands on South Pearl

restaurant.blurb: 6 new leads today: Reunion Bread (Platt Park), Mendocino Farms (Union Station), Monarch pizza (Capitol Hill), CAWA Coffee closure (Virginia Village).

liquor.blurb: Second consecutive zero-application day extends the post-flood silence to five straight days, holding the 7-day total at 2,144 licenses — still 764% above last week's 248-filing baseline. The backend processing anomaly that dumped mass renewals mid-week now represents 99.5% of weekly volume. As April's batch filings exit the rolling window over the next 48 hours, expect the count to crater toward historical norms of 20-30 weekly applications by Thursday.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention today — an Instagram post about Elyria-Swansea rezoning — keeps the 7-day count at 44 across 10 sources, down 6% from last week's 47. Monday's single pickup confirms the weekend editorial drought that began Saturday (1 mention) and bottomed Sunday (0). Instagram dominates with 18 weekly pickups (41% share), followed by Denver Post (7), Facebook (5), X (4). The 44-mention pace runs 7% above April's 41-weekly average, but three consecutive days of minimal activity suggest outlets remain in post-April coast mode while social channels carry baseline coverage.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) pushes MTD to +11 (+2.8/day) and 90-day net to +128. The single-subscriber gain maintains May's opening momentum but underscores persistent volatility: this week's +2 net (24 new, 22 canceled) reflects near-parity between acquisitions and churn, a sharp comedown from last week's +5. MTD's +2.8/day rate runs 100% above YTD's +1.4/day baseline, yet the April 28th mass-cancellation event (17 losses) continues casting shadows. Last two weeks show whipsaw action — April 22's +8 surge followed by April 28's −13 crater — with May opening on steadier footing but still vulnerable to daily churn spikes.
